product.description: Monoprice™ Commercial SeriesExtra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount BracketFor 23" ~ 43" flat and curved TVs* weighing up to 110 poundsThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket features a unique design, giving you full flexibility when mounting your TV from the ceiling. It is designed to easily mount most 23" ~ 43" displays*, with VESA® patterns from 100x100 ~ 200x200 and weighing up to 110 pounds. The adjustable tilting ceiling plate allows for mounting to a flat or sloped ceiling, while the TV plate can swivel and tilt to allow for multiple viewing angles.Fits VESA® patterns from 100x100 ~ 200x200Designed for 23" ~ 43" displays*Supports displays weighing up to 110 pounds±30° swivel range+5° ~ ‑25° tilt rangeExtends from 28.3" ~ 62.6"Convenient cable management systemCan mount to flat and sloped ceilings EXTRA‑LONG ADJUSTABLE CEILING MOUNTThis Monoprice™ Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket offers the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. It can swivel ±30° and tilt from +5° ~ ‑25°. It also allows you to rotate the display ±3° to ensure it is level, while the extra‑long telescoping arm allows you to mount it to higher‑than‑normal ceilings. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 100x100 and 200x200.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 110 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 100x100 and 200x200 and it weighs no more than 110 pounds. EASY CEILING INSTALLATIONThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket features an adjustable tilting ceiling plate, giving you the freedom to mount your screen from a flat or sloped ceiling. This special design also allows for mounting to a single wood stud or roof beam.DESIGNED FOR FLAT SCREEN DISPLAYSThis Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket is designed to mount flat screen displays from 23" ~ 43" in size*. STATE‑OF‑THE‑ART STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket includes a variety of screws, washers, and bushings to mount both curved and flat screen displays, as well as screws and anchors for mounting it to both wood stud and brick/concrete ceilings. We also include box and Allen wrenches for your convenience. CONVENIENT SET OF ESSENTIAL MOUNTING ACCESSORIESThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series Extra‑Long Ceiling TV Mount Bracket includes a variety of screws, washers, and bushings to mount both curved and flat screen displays, as well as screws and anchors for mounting it to both wood stud and brick/concrete ceilings.
